Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 78: Holiday 2007
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #78 shipped to subscribers in December 2007 (bearing the cover date of Holiday 2007 for Issue 78). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #78 wrapped up the massive 2007 release year with a diverse selection of high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, and exclusive holiday media features:

Devil May Cry 4 (stylish hack-and-slash action)
Kingdom Under Fire: Circle of Doom (action RPG / hack-and-slash)
MX vs. ATV Untamed (off-road racing simulation)
Catan (Xbox Live Arcade digital board game strategy)
GriPSHIFT (Xbox Live Arcade stunt driving puzzle-racer)
Omega Five (Xbox Live Arcade side-scrolling shoot 'em up)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc delivered custom downloadable dashboard themes and gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews and special end-of-year features—including OXM's 2007 Game of the Year showcase, previews for upcoming 2008 titles like Resident Evil 5 and Ninja Gaiden II, alongside the monthly Top Plays segment.
